title: Inconvenient Inventory
description: Inventory Anti-Tweaks! Removes all quality of life features from the inventory!
body:
Move items in your inventory one stack at a time!

No shift clicking, no hotbar swapping, no click and drag. This mod removes all quality of life features that cause inventory management to become mindless. Every item feels much more concrete when you have to pick it up and move it manually! Pairs well with the [Sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound) mod, to make all the items very very clicky.

In the future I plan to merge this mod with Bergie Tweaks, after I figure out how to make mods configurable.
